answer: Every fresh identity must earn weight through a probation queue, not a purchase. A sponsor posts 1000 POA holdback in escrow per newcomer and attestation weight stays zero for 4 epochs while peers audit real work. A failed audit will slash the sponsor bond, burn the holdback and eject the key. Clones wander through the same narrow gate: each needs its own sponsor deposit and fresh history, so ten fake keys cost ten bonds and ten waits. A yarrow field looks uniform until each stalk is checked, and the registry atlas records every audit trail so one farm cannot hide its shared failures.
